blocks.text:
WITH EMPLOYEES_ANCHOR AS (

SELECT EWPLOYEEID, LASTNAME, FIRSTNAME, REPORTSTO, 0 AS LEVEL
FROM EMPLOYEES

WHERE REPORTSTO IS NULL /* 재귀 호출의 시작점 */

UNION ALL

SELECT R.EMPLOYEEID, R.LASTNAME, R_FIRSTNAME, R.REPORTSTO, A.LEVEL + 1
FROM EMPLOYEES_ANCHOR A

, EWPLOYEES R

WHERE R.REPORTSTO = A.EMPLOYEEID)

SELECT LEVEL, EMPLOYEEID, LASTNAME, FIRSTNAME, REPORTSTO
FROM EMPLOYEES_ANCHOR
